name: Booking and appointments
summary: A scheduling flow where a user picks a service/resource and an available time slot; the system prevents double booking and keeps availability in sync.
entities: slot and booking: start, end, status, customer
mechanics: Generate slots from working hours, duration and buffer; exclude breaks and existing bookings.
Create a booking only if the slot is still free (atomic check).
Cancel/reschedule frees the old slot and validates the new one.
Show availability in the user's timezone; handle DST.
Optional: capacity per slot, waitlist, reminders.
ux: Step flow: service → date → slot → details → confirmation.
Disabled past/full slots; clear confirmation and cancellation.
Show the timezone and duration; prevent double submit.
pitfalls: Race condition: two users book the same slot.
Slot generation ignoring duration/buffer or breaks.
Timezone/DST bugs; date-only vs datetime mixing.
Cancel keeps the slot blocked; reschedule leaves a ghost booking.
No validation for past dates or malformed times.
defaults: One service, one resource, local time, no payment.
Slot step based on service duration and a 10-minute buffer.

suffix.en: Book a single resource with one availability calendar.
suffix.tr: Tek kaynak ve tek müsaitlik takvimi ile rezervasyon yap.

suffix.en: Support multiple staff/rooms, each with its own availability.
suffix.tr: Her biri kendi müsaitliğine sahip birden fazla personel/oda destekle.

suffix.en: Do not add payment; confirm the booking directly.
Add a payment step before confirmation.

verification: Slots respect working hours, service duration, buffer and breaks.
An existing booking removes its slot from availability.
Two bookings cannot occupy the same resource and time; the second is rejected.
Cancel frees the slot; reschedule validates the new slot and releases the old one.
Past dates/times and malformed input are rejected with a visible message.
Timezone/DST display is correct for the selected timezone.
Double submit does not create duplicate bookings.
